notes.title: Small Update - Fixed a series of bugs 1.15
notes.content:
Thank you all for your support for The Lost Island 4: Cabin Experiment! Thanks to the feedback from players, we discovered several hidden bugs in the game during the first week and promptly made adjustments and fixes.

Fixed the following bugs on certain devices during gameplay:
1.Fix Android 14 device crash issues
2.In some cases, the item bar image size was incorrect.
3.Some devices experienced a black screen and were unable to run the game.
4.Bugs related to the battery item at the beginning.
5.Some items were missing after the game is closed.
6.Rapid clicking the astronaut resulted in obtaining multiple white fruits.
7.A few errors in the text.
8.Few animation playback errors.

Hope you enjoy this familiar yet unfamiliar, mysterious and unpredictable journey.
